title: L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

reports.title: Messerangriff auf Kinder: Täter «kaufte Rindfleisch, um zu üben»
Chinese hatte Tat zusammen mit ChatGPT geplant!
Zürich-Oerlikon: Angriff auf Kinder eines Kinderhortes mit Verletzungsfolgen
L'homme qui a attaqué une garderie suisse a trouvé ses victimes sur ChatGPT

summary:
On 1 October 2024, a 23-year-old Chinese student attacked three five-year-old boys outside a childcare centre in Zurich Oerlikon with a knife whose blade was about 8.5 centimetres long. One boy had a major vein at his collarbone completely cut and needed emergency surgery, another suffered two chest stabs that damaged his heart and major blood vessels and nearly died, and the third was wounded in the ear and lung. A childcare worker grabbed the attacker's arms until he dropped the knife and surrendered, and passersby held him for police.

Prosecutors say the man planned the attack for weeks, using ChatGPT to ask about legal consequences of stabbing random victims, ordering knives and clothing, studying anatomy, and buying raw beef to practise cuts. They describe him as extremely cold blooded and say he acted out of revenge, desire for attention, and ideological delusion. He faces trial on Thursday for attempted murder, and the prosecution is seeking a 15 year prison sentence and a 15 year expulsion from Switzerland.
title_en: The man who attacked a Swiss daycare found his victims on ChatGPT
